doc: $~Main aisa @StructureDefinition nahin hoon jo aap asal mein bana saken. Lekin main bahut aham hoon, kyunki main hamare naach ke sab se aham @elements ko ilham deta hoon: @Phrase, @Group, aur @Stage.
Inhein istemaal karna seekhne ke liye in se milein.

$~Main @Phrase, @Shape aur @Group ko ek saath @Stage par ek @Arrangement ke zariye sajata hoon. Arre, adaab, aap kaise hain? Jab doosre aas paas hon to main hamesha theek rehta hoon, is liye aap ke saath hona bahut accha hai!
Kaam karne ke liye mujhe aap se ek @Arrangement chahiye, aur phir sajane ke liye @Output ki ek @List.
Masalan, yahan main ek @Stack tarteeb ke saath hoon aur kuch @Phrase ko seedha khade rukh jama rahe hain:
\Group(Stack() [Phrase('pehla') Phrase('doosra')])\
Main cheezon ko kaise sajata hoon, yeh us @Arrangement par munhasir hai jo aap mujhe dete hain.

doc: $~Main @Stage par @Text mein sab se pyaari hoon. Hello, hello! Mujhe yaad hai? Koi mujhe kaise bhool sakta hai /me/.
Bas mujhe aise banayein, aur main @Stage par nazar aaungi:

Mujhe dikhne ke liye @TextLiteral ya @FormattedLiteral chahiye. @FormattedLiteral ke saath, main \`*mota* aur /tirchha/`\ jaisi cheezein istemaal kar sakti hoon ya aapke banaye hue @ConceptLink ka zikr kar sakti hoon.
Aap mujhe woh sab kuch bhi de sakte hain jo ek @Output kar sakta hai, jaise mera size, font, ghumaav badalna, aur @Pose aur @Sequence ke saath mere tamam kamaal ke naach.
Aap mujhe @Stage par chun kar saath wale palette 🎨 se badal bhi sakte hain. Yeh alag alag font aazmane aur apne @Text ke liye sahi /khat/ chunne ka bohat achha tareeqa hai.

doc: $~Baat karne wala bubble jo dikhata hai main kya keh rahi hoon, aur seedha mujh ki taraf ishara karta hai. Yahan chaar alag cheezein ho sakti hain.
Saada matn, jo main dikhati hoon aur kuch nahin:
\Phrase('a' bulbula: 'hello!')\
@markup, agar aap mere alfaaz mein *mota* ya /tirchha/ likhna chahein.
Ek @Say, jo main dikhati *aur* zor se bolti bhi hoon:
\Phrase('a' bulbula: Say('hello!'))\
Ek @Bubble, jab aap chunna chahein ke main kis taraf se bolun, ise soch bana dein, ya ise rang dein.

$~Mere har glyph ke liye @Pose, ek ke baad ek. Pehle glyph ko pehla pose milta hai, doosre ko doosra, aur jab poses khatam ho jayein to main phir pehle se shuru karti hoon. @placeholder bhi glyph gine jaate hain.

\Phrase(
	'jashn!'
	adaayen: [
		Pose(rang: Color(25% 70 250°))
		Pose(rang: Color(50% 80 300°))
		Pose(rang: Color(58% 90 60°))
	]
)\
Har glyph apne beech ke gird ghoomta, barhta aur hilta hai, is liye ek pose har glyph ko apni jagah par tirchha kar deta hai jabke meri line seedhi rehti hai:
\Phrase('daghmagata hua' adaayen: Pose(ghumaao: 15°))\
Glyph ka apna rang mere rang par aur mere animate kiye hue har pose par bhaari hota hai, aur us ki opacity meri opacity ke saath mil jaati hai.
$~Ek naam jo aap mujhe dete hain! Yeh bohat si baaton ke liye madadgaar hai.

Aakhir mein, main @Choice ke saath madadgaar hoon: jo naam aap mujhe dete hain woh us @stream mein nazar aate hain.
Agar madadgaar ho to aap mujhe kai alag naam de sakte hain, har naam ek alag @language mein. Main hamesha pehli chuni hui zubaan ka naam istemaal karoon ga.

doc: $~Main matn ko @Stage par dikhane ke bajaye bol kar sunata hoon. Hi!
Bas mujhe kuch kehne ko dein, aur jab bhi mujhe diya gaya matn badlega, main usay bolunga:
\Say('bla bla bla')\

Main matn ko usi @language mein bolta hoon jis ka tag usay laga hota hai, aur bina tag wale matn ko us zubaan mein jo aap ke program ne chuni ho. Agar aap alag alag zubaanon ka matn jodein, to main har hissa us ki apni zubaan mein bolta hoon:
\Say('hola '/es + 'dost'/ur)\
Aap settings mein ek aawaaz chun sakte hain.

doc: $~Main sur (notes) ko aawaaz mein badalta hoon: ek ya zyada @Track ek saath bajte hain, ek raftaar par, ek kunji mein, ek scale ke mutabiq. Main woh mausiqi hoon jo aap sun /aur/ dekh sakte hain — har dekhne wala khud chunta hai ke main kaise nazar aaun.
Sab se chhota gaana ek track par teen sur ka hota hai:
\Music(Track([1 3 5]))\

Sur ginti hote hain. 1 scale ka pehla sur hai — woh jis par dhun mukammal lagti hai — 2 us se agla oopar wala sur hai, aur 8 wahi pehla sur hai, ek octave oopar. ø ek wakfa hai, yaani khamoshi. Ginti dono taraf aage barhti rehti hai: 9 doosra sur hai ek octave oopar, aur 0 aur -1 pehle sur se neeche jaate hain.

Ek /scale/ un thode se suron ka majmua hai jin se ek tukda banta hai, aur kaun se sur hain, yeh us ke mizaaj ka zyada tar hissa tay karta hai. Agar aap kuch na kahein to @Music/scale \Music.major\ hota hai, jo roshan lagta hai; \Music.minor\ bilkul unhi ginti se zyada udaas lagta hai. Ek /kunji/ yeh hai ke poora tukda kitna oonchi ya neechi jagah par hai, jo @Music/key se tay hoti hai. Aur @Music/tempo yeh hai ke woh kitni tez bajta hai, har minute ke beats mein — beat woh yaksaan dhadkan hai jis par aap taali bajayenge.
Kyunki sur ginti hain aur tay shuda aawaaz nahin, is liye teeno cheezein dhun ko chhue baghair badal sakti hain. Yeh wahi teen sur hain, zyada udaas, neeche, aur dheere:

\Music(
	Track([1 3 5])
	paimaana: Music.minor
	kunji: -5semitones
	raftaar: 60beats/min
)\

Ek track apne aakhir par pahunch kar dobara shuru ho jaata hai, is liye chhoti si fehrist ek dhun hai jo hamesha bajti rehti hai. Yeh chaar beat lambi hai, aur beech ki khaali jagahon mein wakfe hain:
\Music(Track([1 ø 5 ø]) raftaar: 90beats/min)\

Mujhe tracks ki fehrist dein to woh ek saath bajte hain, har ek ka apna saaz, raftaar aur awaaz ka zor hota hai. Yahan bass drum aur snare beat ko qaim rakhte hain jabke hi-hat dugni raftaar se chalta hai — ek hi ginti se ek polyrhythm. Drums ek kit hain, sur wale nahin, is liye un ki ginti sur ke bajaye kit ke hisse chunti hain:

\Music(
	[
		Track([1 ø 2 ø 1 ø 2 ø] saaz: Instrument.drums)
		Track(
			[3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3]
			saaz: Instrument.drums
			taal: 0.5beats
			awaaz: 30%
		)
	]
	raftaar: 96beats/min
)\

Qaus ke andar ginti ek saath ek chord ki tarah bajti hain, aur kisi ginti par likha gaya sur @value us entry ko apni lambai deta hai. Yahan do poore sur wale chord chalti hui dhun ke neeche tikte hain:
Jo bhi ginti banata hai, woh mausiqi bana sakta hai. Yeh dhun khud ko naye tarteeb mein milati hai, aur is baat ko follow karti hai ke aap kitni zor se bol rahe hain:

\Music(
	Track([1 2 3 5 3 2 1].shuffled())
	raftaar: (60 + (Volume() · 120)) · 1beats/min
)\

Kisi ko mujhe sunna zaroori nahin. @Beat har beat ko bajte waqt bata deta hai, taake aap mausiqi ko bajane ke saath saath bana bhi sakein, us visualization ke saath jo dekhne wale ne chuni ho. @Beat ke paas hamesha ek @Downbeat hota hai, is liye aap use bina kuch jaanche parh sakte hain:

\dhun: Beat()
ginti: dhun.count
Stage(
	[
		Phrase(
			'◆'
			size: 1m + ((ginti % 4) = 0 ? 2m 0m)
			jagah: Place(-2m 2m)
		)
		Phrase(
			'◆'
			size: 1m + ((ginti % 4) = 2 ? 2m 0m)
			jagah: Place(2m 2m)
		)
		Music(Track([1 ø 5 ø] saaz: Instrument.drums))
	]
)\

Mera apna koi andaaz nahin jis ko saja saken, is liye main aam zaahiri inputs mein se koi nahin leta — na size, na jagah, na rang, na animation. Main kaisa nazar aaun, yeh dekhne wale ki pasand hai, jo woh apni settings mein karta hai, aur woh stage se jura hota hai, aap ke layout mein nahin; main koi jagah nahin ghairta, is liye mujhe @Row ya @Stack mein rakhne se mere paas ki koi cheez nahin hilti. Mausiqi ko khud banane ke liye @Beat istemaal karein: woh aap ko har beat bajte waqt deta hai, taake aap jo chahein output chala sakein.

Main evaluation ke dauran bajta rehta hoon: jab main baj raha hoon to mere sur badlein, aur tabdeeli agle beat par jud jaati hai, dobara shuru hone ke bajaye, aur isi se dhun ko beech mein badalna mausiqi jaisa lagta hai. Mujhe shuru se dobara bajane ke liye @Music/replay dekhein; mujhe roke rakhne aur usi jagah se dobara shuru karne ke liye @Music/pause dekhein.

tracks.doc: $~Ek @Track, ya un ki fehrist jo ek hi waqt mein bajti hai. Har track ek aawaaz hai jis ka ek saaz hota hai, is liye un ki fehrist ek toli hai.

tempo.doc: $~Main kitni tez bajta hoon, har minute ke beats mein. Beat woh yaksaan dhadkan hai jis par aap taali bajayenge, is liye 120beats/min ka matlab har second mein do beat hai, jo tez chalne ki raftaar ke qareeb hai. Ginti ko aadha karne se har cheez do guna der leti hai, aur ek bhi sur nahin badalta.

doc: $~Main jo bhi sur bajata hoon, un sab ko kitna upar ya neeche khiskana hai.

Ikaai semitone hai. Semitone maghribi mausiqi ka sab se chhota qadam hai: piano par yeh ek kunji se bilkul agli kunji tak ka faasla hai, kaali kunjiyan bhi ginte hue, aur baarah semitone mil kar ek octave banate hain. Is liye \kunji: 12semitones\🪲 wahi dhun hai jo ek octave upar ho, \kunji: -12semitones\🪲 ek octave neeche, aur \kunji: 2semitones\🪲 usay zara sa upar dhakelta hai.

Yahan do tarah ki ginti milti hain, aur inhein aapas mein milaana aasaan hai. Sur /scale ke qadam/ ginte hain, jahan octave \8\ hota hai: \1\ se \8\ tak ek octave hai. Kunji /semitone/ ginti hai, jahan octave \12\ hota hai. Dono ek hi faasle ko bayaan karte hain: saat surun wale scale mein \1\ se \8\ tak ke aath qadam baarah semitone ke barabar hain. Kunji semitone mein naapi jaati hai kyunki semitone har scale mein ek jitna hota hai, jabke qadam aisa nahin: @Music/scale ke pentatonic mein ek octave mein paanch sur hain aur major mein saat, is liye qadamon se khiskane par har scale alag faasla tay karta, jabke \12semitones\ har scale mein ek octave hai.

Kyunki kunji sirf ek number hai, yeh kahin se bhi aa sakti hai. Yahan poori dhun do semitone upar uthti hai jab /up/ muntakhab ho — @Choice ko stage par koi chuni jaane wali cheez chahiye jise woh parh sake, aur yeh dono jumle yahi kaam karte hain:

\Stage(
	[
		Phrase(
			'up'
			chunaJaSakneWala: ⊤
			naam: 'up'
			jagah: Place(-2m 0m)
		)
		Phrase(
			'ghar'
			chunaJaSakneWala: ⊤
			naam: 'ghar'
			jagah: Place(2m 0m)
		)
		Music(
			Track([1 3 5 8 5 3])
			kunji: (Choice() = 'up' ? 2semitones 0semitones)
		)
	]
)\
$~Mere numberon ka matlab kaun se sur hain: pehle sur se semitone ke faasloon ki list.

Scale un chhote surun ka majmua hai jin se dhun banti hai, aur scale chunna mizaaj chunne ka zyada hissa hai. Wahi dhun \Music.major\ mein roshan lagti hai, \Music.minor\ mein udaas, aur \Music.wholeTone\ mein khwaab jaisi, jabke ek bhi number nahin badalta.

Mere kuch scales mein koi galat sur nahin hota: \Music.pentatonic\, \Music.minorPentatonic\ aur \Music.blues\ kisi bhi tarteeb mein achhe lagte hain, is liye yeh shuru karne ke liye achhi jagah hain. Doosre jaan boojh kar tez hain — \Music.altered\, \Music.diminished\ aur \Music.locrian\ be-sura sunaai denge, aur yehi unka maqsad hai.
Aap apni list bhi likh sakte hain. Yeh ek pentatonic scale hai jo likh kar dikhaya gaya hai: \[0semitones 2semitones 4semitones 7semitones 9semitones]\

volume.doc: $~Main kul mila kar kitna buland hoon, \0%\ se \100%\ tak. Har @Track ki apni awaaz bhi hoti hai, jo is ke muqable mein naapi jaati hai, is liye meri awaaz kam karne se poora gurooh ek saath dheema ho jaata hai.

doc: $~Jab yeh kisi jaanch par \⊤\ ho, to main shuru se dobara chalta hoon, chahe mere surun mein koi tabdeeli na hui ho.

Yeh un awaazon ke liye hai jo kisi waqiye ka jawab dein, na ke musalsal baje. Agar sahi jawab par ding bajta hai, to lagataar do sahi jawab bilkul ek jaisi mausiqi banate hain, is liye kuch nahin badalta aur kuch dobara nahin bajta. Main woh hoon jis se aap kehte hain /dobara, abhi/ — neeche /right/ do baar chunein to ding do baar bajega:

\Stage(
	[
		Phrase(
			'right'
			chunaJaSakneWala: ⊤
			naam: 'right'
			jagah: Place(-2m 0m)
		)
		Phrase(
			'ghalat'
			chunaJaSakneWala: ⊤
			naam: 'ghalat'
			jagah: Place(2m 0m)
		)
		Music(
			Track([1 5 8] saaz: Instrument.bell chakkar: ⊥)
			dobaara: ∆ Choice() ? (Choice() = 'right') ⊥
		)
	]
)\

Mujhe ek /lamhaati/ @condition dein, jo sirf usi jaanch par sach ho jis ko waqiye ne shuru kiya, jaise upar wala \∆ Choice()\. \score > 10\🪲 jaisi qaayam rehne wali shart ek baar sach hone ke baad sach rehti hai, is liye woh us ke baad har jaanch par mujhe dobara shuru kar degi.
$~Jab tak yeh \⊤\ hai main ruka rehta hoon, aur jab yeh wapas \⊥\ hota hai to main usi dhadkan se aage badhta hoon jahan ruka tha.

Yehi mujhe @Music/replay se alag karta hai: replay ka matlab /shuru se karo/ hai, aur mera matlab /yahin ruko/ hai. Jo sur rukte waqt bhi baj raha tha, woh dobara shuru hone par apna bacha hua hissa poora bajata hai, is liye lambe chord ke beech mein rukne se woh zaaya nahin hota. Neeche /hold/ aur /go/ chunein:

\Stage(
	[
		Phrase(
			'hold'
			chunaJaSakneWala: ⊤
			naam: 'hold'
			jagah: Place(-2m 0m)
		)
		Phrase(
			'jaana'
			chunaJaSakneWala: ⊤
			naam: 'jaana'
			jagah: Place(2m 0m)
		)
		Music(
			Track([1 3 5 8 5 3] saaz: Instrument.piano)
			waqfa: Choice() = 'hold'
		)
	]
)\

Replay ke bar'aks, mujhe ek /qaayam/ @condition chahiye, jo utni der sach rahe jitni der aap khamoshi chahte hain. Mere @Beat ki ginti bhi mere saath ruk jaati hai aur wahin se aage barhti hai, sifar se dobara shuru nahin hoti.

name.doc: $~Mera naam, jo meri pehchaan hai. Isay rakhein to mere surun ki tabdeeliyan mere bajte hue andar judti jaati hain; isay badlein to main ek naye tukde ki tarah shuru se chalta hoon. Yehi woh cheez hai jis par @Beat chhaant sakta hai, is liye ek saath bajte do tukde alag pehchane ja sakte hain.

description.doc: $~Mera bayaan, jo screen reader tab bolte hain jab mujhe suna nahin ja sakta.

major.doc: $~Major scale, meri pehle se tay shuda: roshan aur jaani pehchaani.

minor.doc: $~Natural minor scale: major se zyada gehri.

chromatic.doc: $~Saare baarah semitone, is liye darje aur semitone ek jaise hain.

pentatonic.doc: $~Major pentatonic scale: paanch sur, aur koi galat nahin — har darja har doosre ke saath achha lagta hai.

minorPentatonic.doc: $~Minor pentatonic scale: paanch sur, aur koi galat nahin.

blues.doc: $~Blues scale: minor pentatonic aur ek flat paanch. Yahan bhi koi galat sur nahin.

dorian.doc: $~Dorian mode: minor jis mein chhatha sur uncha hai, jaaz jaisa darmiyaani mizaaj.

phrygian.doc: $~Phrygian mode: minor jis mein doosra sur neecha hai, gehra aur Hispani rang liye hue.

lydian.doc: $~Lydian mode: major jis mein chautha sur uncha hai, halka phulka aur roshan.

mixolydian.doc: $~Mixolydian mode: major, lekin saatvein sur ko neecha kar ke, blues jaisa aur adhoora sa.

locrian.doc: $~Locrian mode: jaan boojh kar tanaao wala, jis mein doosra aur paanchwan sur neecha hota hai. Agar aap ne isay aasaan jazz samajh kar chuna tha, to is ke bajaye bemel aawaazon ke liye tayyar rahein.

melodicMinor.doc: $~Melodic minor scale: minor, lekin chhatha aur saatwan sur uncha kar ke. Bohat si jazz harmony ki buniyaad yehi hai.

harmonicMinor.doc: $~Harmonic minor scale: minor, lekin saatwan sur uncha kar ke. Yeh dramaai aur purane zamaane jaisi lagti hai.

lydianDominant.doc: $~Lydian dominant scale: lydian, lekin saatwan sur neecha kar ke. Yeh melodic minor ka chautha mode hai.

altered.doc: $~Altered scale: jaan boojh kar bemel, dominant chords par tanaao paida karne ke liye. Yahan kuchh sur ghalat lagte hain, aur yehi is ka maqsad hai.

bebopDominant.doc: $~Bebop dominant scale: mixolydian aur ek natural saatwan sur, aath sur taake runs beat par khatam hon.

bebopMajor.doc: $~Bebop major scale: major aur ek uncha paanchwan sur, aath sur taake runs beat par khatam hon.

wholeTone.doc: $~Whole tone scale: chhe barabar fasle wale sur, khwaab jaisi, jis mein wapas lautne ka koi ghar nahin.

diminished.doc: $~Diminished scale: baari baari poora aur aadha qadam, tanaao wali aur hum-shakl.

doc: $~Main @Music mein ek aawaaz hoon: suron ki ek silsila jo ek @Instrument bajata hai.

Mere sur adad hain, wohi adad jo @Music samjhata hai — 1 scale ka pehla sur hai, 8 wohi sur ek octave upar hai, ø khaamoshi hai, aur \{1 3 5}\ jaise braces mein adad ek saath chord ki tarah bajte hain:
\Music(Track([1 ø {1 3 5} 8]))\

Sur poore adad hi hon, zaroori nahin. \1.5\ pehle aur doosre sur ke darmiyaan hai, aur dono bajte hain — qareeb wala zyada tez — is liye adad ko suron par sarkaana aisa lagta hai jaise piano ki kunjiyaan dabayi jaa rahi hon:
\Music(Track([1 1.2 1.4 1.6 1.8 2] taal: 0.5beats))\
Mera @Track/mash \⊥\ par rakhein, to is tarah ka adad do sur bajane ke bajaye ek sur ko pitch se hata kar mor deta hai.
Har entry meri @Track/beat tak chalti hai, jo ek beat hai jab tak aap isay na badlein. Isay badalne se main jo kuchh bajata hoon woh sab ek saath dobara tarteeb paata hai.

Jab koi ek entry baqi se lambi ya chhoti honi ho, to lambaai adad par hi ek note @value ke tor par likhein. \8𝅗𝅥\ aadha note hai — ek beat se do guna lamba — aur is ke aas paas kuchh likhne ki zaroorat nahin:

Paanch qeematein hain: \𝅝\ chaar beats tak chalta hai, \𝅗𝅥\ do, \𝅘𝅥\ ek, \𝅘𝅥𝅮\ aadha beat, aur \𝅘𝅥𝅯\ ek beat ka chauthaai. In mein se kisi ke baad nuqta lagane se woh aadha aur lamba ho jata hai, to \𝅘𝅥𝅭\ derh beat ka hai. Chauthaai note ek beat ka hota hai chahe meri beat kuchh bhi ho, is liye \dhun: 1𝅘𝅥𝅮\🪲 wohi kehta hai jo \0.5beats\ kehta hai, aur zyada saaf parha jata hai. Chord par, qeemat pehle adad par rakhein: \{1𝅗𝅥 3 5}\.
Yeh dhoondhna mushkil hai, is liye @editor ke neeche ki alaamaton ki qataar inhein tab dikhati hai jab aap ka cursor mere kisi adad ke bilkul baad ho.
Khaamoshi qeemat nahin rakh sakti, kyunke \ø\ adad nahin hai. Do khaamoshiyan ek saath do guni lambi hoti hain, aur is se bareek kaam ke liye @Note hai.

Jab kisi ek sur ko apni alag awaaz chahiye ho, ya aisi lambaai chahiye jo koi qeemat na likh sake, to us ek ko @Note mein lapeitein. Isay sirf wahin istemaal karein jahan zaroorat ho: saada adad parhna aasaan hai, is liye zyada tar tracks mein yeh hota hi nahin, aur isi nayaab hone se @Note ek waqiye ki tarah numaya hota hai.

Round ke liye bas khaamoshiyon se bharna kaafi hai: dono hisson mein beats ki tadaad barabar hoti hai, is liye woh saath saath chalte hain aur alag nahin hote. Do lists ko : se ek mein phailana unhein banane ka tareeqa hai, kyunke \append\ ko dono lists mein ek hi qism ki cheez chahiye.

notes.doc: $~Bajane wale sur, tarteeb se: sur ke liye ek adad, khaamoshi ke liye \ø\, chord ke liye \{1 3 5}\ jaisa ek set, ya @Note jab kisi ek entry ko apni alag awaaz chahiye. Adad par likha hua note @value — \3𝅗𝅥\ — batata hai ke woh ek entry kitni der chalti hai.

instrument.doc: $~Woh @Instrument jo mujhe bajata hai. Kuchh instruments pitched hote hain, to mere adad sur chunte hain; doosre kits hote hain, jahan mere adad aawaazein chunte hain. Har instrument batata hai ke woh kaun sa hai.

beat.doc: $~Ek saada entry beats mein kitni der chalti hai. Yeh ek beat hai jab tak aap isay na badlein, aur badalne se main jo kuchh bajata hoon woh sab ek saath dobara tarteeb paata hai: \0.5beats\ par har entry aathwan note hai, to main usi list se do guni raftaar se guzarta hoon. Ek note @value wohi baat zyada saaf kehta hai, to \dhun: 1𝅘𝅥𝅮\🪲 wohi aathwan note wala grid hai.

scale.doc: $~Sirf mere liye ek scale, jo @Music/scale ko badal deti hai, jab ek aawaaz ko baqiyon se alag sur istemaal karne hon.

key.doc: $~Ek tabdeeli sirf mere liye, semitone mein, jo @Music/key ko badal deti hai — us waqt ke liye jab ek aawaaz baqi se oonchi ya neechi honi chahiye. Ek track ko ek octave neecha karne se bass line unhi numbers se ban jaati hai jinse dhun banti hai.

volume.doc: $~Meri aawaaz kitni tez hai, \0%\ se \100%\ tak, music ki aawaaz ke muqabil naapi gayi, taake halki si sang-e-saaz dhun ke neeche reh sake.

pan.doc: $~Main donon speakers ke beech kahan hoon: \-1\ poori tarah baayein, \0\ beech mein, aur \1\ poori tarah daayein. Tracks ko alag alag phailane se har ek ko pehchanna aasaan ho jaata hai.

loop.doc: $~Kya main apne aakhir par pohnch kar dobara shuru hota hoon. Main hota hoon, siwaye is ke ke yeh \⊥\ ho, jo ek baar ki aawaaz jaise ding ko chahiye.

mash.doc: $~Do suron ke beech wale sur ka kya hota hai. \1.5\ \1\ aur \2\ ke theek beech mein hai: agar yeh \⊥\ na ho, to dono bajte hain, qareeb wala zyada tez, jaise piano ki do chaabiyan ek saath dabane par. \⊥\ ke saath aapko ek hi sur milta hai, jo un ke beech apne faasle ke hisaab se pitch se hata hua hota hai.

words.doc:
$~@Instrument/voice ke gaane ke liye bol. Har sur ke liye ek bol, @placeholder se alag kiye hue, to \'so mi fa'\ teen sur gaata hai aur khaali jagahein batati hain ke ek bol kahan khatam hota hai aur agla kahan shuru hota hai.

Khamoshi ko koi bol nahin chahiye, is liye gaana un suron par aata hai jo waqai bajte hain. Agar bol suron se kam hon, to woh khamosh hone ke bajaye shuru se dobara shuru ho jaate hain. Agar bilkul na hon, to aawaaz ek /uh/ aawaaz rokti hai.

Kisi bol ko hyphen par khatam karein to woh agle sur par bhi ruka rehta hai, har hyphen par ek aur sur — yun aap ek bol ko kai suron par gaate hain. \Track([1 2 3 4] alfaaz: 'la- mi so')\ mein, \la\ pehle do suron ko dhakta hai, phir \mi\ aur \so\ ek ek lete hain.

Hijje <International Phonetic Alphabet@https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_Phonetic_Alphabet> ke hain, jahan har harf ek aawaaz hai. Har aawaaz dekhne aur sunne ke liye @editor ke neeche 🤖 dabayein. Jo harf main nahin pehchanta woh chhor diye jaate hain. Aawaaz ke siwa har saaz mujhe nazar andaaz karta hai, is liye @Track/instrument badalne aur wapas karne par bhi bol bache rehte hain.

doc: $~Main @Track mein ek entry hoon jo apni alag aawaaz rakhti hai, ya aisi lambai jo koi note @value nahin likh sakta.

Zyadatar notes saade numbers hi rehne chahiyein, aur zyadatar lambaiyan number par hi likhne se chhoti hoti hain: \1𝅗𝅥\ aadha note hai. Main tab kaam aata hoon jab ek note ko apni aawaaz chahiye, ya aisi lambai jo qeematon ke beech aaye — aur kyunki \Note(1 2beats ÷ 3)\ \1\ se kahin zyada kehta hai, mujhe har jagah istemaal karne se zaroori notes dab jayenge.
Triplet seedha hisaab hai: \Note(1 2beats ÷ 3)\ kehta hai ke yeh teen do beat bharte hain. Meri lambai note ki qeemat bhi ho sakti hai, is liye \Note(1 1𝅗𝅥)\ aur \Note(1 2beats)\ wahi do beat hain.
\Music(Track([1 1 Note(5 2beats awaaz: 60%) ø]))\

degree.doc: $~Kya bajana hai: note ke liye ek number, khamoshi ke liye \ø\, ya chord ke liye numbers ka set, bilkul waise hi jaise @Track mein saadi entry hoti. Number par @value wala note — \3𝅗𝅥\ — batata hai ke main kitni der chalta hoon, aur agar aap dono likhein to @Note/beat par ghalib aata hai.

beat.doc: $~Main kitne beat chalta hoon. Mujhe istemaal karne ki poori wajah yehi hai: @Track mein har saadi entry barabar der chalti hai, aur main woh tareeqa hoon jis se ek note ko alag lambai milti hai. Yahan @value wala note bhi kaam karta hai, is liye \1𝅗𝅥\ aur \2beats\ ki lambai ek jaisi hai.

volume.doc: $~Meri aawaaz kitni tez hai, jo @Track ki aawaaz ko badal deti hai, ek akele note par zor dene ke liye.

doc: $~Main un saazon mein se ek ka naam hoon jo @Track bajा sakta hai. Main ek tay shuda faehrist hoon: mujhe naam se chunein, jaise \Instrument.piano\ ya \Instrument.🎹\.

Hum mein se zyadatar /pitched/ hain, yaani track ke numbers sur chunte hain aur bade numbers oonche sunayi dete hain. Baqi /kits/ hain: number sur ke bajaye ginti wali faehrist mein se ek aawaaz chunta hai, is liye track dhun ke bajaye taal jaisa parha jaata hai, aur faehrist ke aakhir se aage ke numbers ghoom kar uske shuru par aa jaate hain.

Hum mein se zyadatar asli recordings bhi hain, un saazon se li gayi jo logon ne waqai bajaye. Synthesizers kisi ki naqal nahin karte — woh oscillators se bane hain, aur wahi unki aawaaz hai. Hum mein se har ek neeche batata hai ke hum kaun se hain.

doc: $~Main waqt ke saath @Output ko @Pose ki ek silsile se harkat deta hoon! Kya aap mere saath naachna chahte hain? Yeh aasaan hai.
Aapko bas mujhe ek @Map dena hai, jahan har @key batata hai ke hum naach mein kitne fisad aage hain, aur un kunjiyon ka har @value ek @Pose hai jo banna hai.
Is se harkat dene ke /bohat/ saare tareeqe hain! Misal ke taur par, yeh ek saada tareeqa hai:
Yeh kehta hai, /shuru mein (0%), tilt 360 se aaghaz karo, aur tilt 0 par khatam karo/. Yeh hamein hamesha goal chakkar mein ghumata rahega, kyunki main @Phrase ki aaraam wali @state par laga hoon!
Doosre inputs ke saath khel kar apne khud ke takhleeqi naach aazmayein.

Meri jagah batati hai ke haath stage par kahan hai, meri ungliyan batati hain ke kitni phaili hui hain, meri khuli @state sach hoti hai jab haath khula ho (3 ya zyada ungliyan phaili hon), aur mera angootha, @index, beech wali, ring aur chhoti ungli har ek batati hai ke kaun si ungli phaili hui hai. Expression.doc: $~!Main chehre ke taassur ki ek tasveer hoon jo camera ne pehchaani, aur @Face @stream ne bheji. Meri jagah batati hai ke chehra stage par kahan hai. Mere @Expression.leftEyeOpen, @Expression.rightEyeOpen aur @Expression.eyesOpen batate hain ke aankhein khuli hain ya nahin. Mere @Expression.mouthOpen, @Expression.smiling, @Expression.frowning aur @Expression.browsRaised batate hain ke chehra kya kar raha hai, aur har ek ki ek matching miqdaar (@Expression.mouthOpenAmount, @Expression.smileAmount, @Expression.frownAmount, @Expression.browRaiseAmount) 0 se 1 tak hai jo batati hai ke woh kitna tez hai. doc: $~Aap jaante hain na ke mansoobon mein ek se zyada @Source file ho sakti hain? Mein aap ko aap ke mansoobe ke mantiq par ek @Source banane deta hoon. Yeh bohat kaam aata hai agar aap mansoobe ke alag alag chalne ke darmiyan kuch data bachana chahte hain.

Misaal ke tor par, sochein aap ek seedha sa counter banana chahte hain jo har baar mouse button dabane par ek se barhta hai. Aap ise yaad rakhne ke liye istemaal kar sakte hain ke aap ne koi kaam kitni baar kiya.

\↓ count
[
	Phrase(`\count\ baar!`)
	Source('ginti' count … ∆ Button() … count + 1)
]\🪲

Ise copy karke dekhein, ek naya @Source banayein jis ka naam /count/ ho aur usmein 0 likhein, taake ginti 0 se shuru ho. Yeh chhota sa mansooba /count/ maakhaz mein se @value le ga aur jab bhi mouse button dabaya jaye ga, /count/ @Source ko mojooda /count/ qeemat plus /1/ kar ke badal de ga.
